title: NIFTY IT P/E Ratio
description: The NIFTY IT P/E ratio today is 20 as of 30 Oct, 2026, against a 10-year median of 25.1. IT earnings are largely dollar-denominated while the multiple is set in rupees, so the sector re-rates on global technology spending and on the exchange rate at the same time.
